prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1493; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle reportedly backed into a parked sedan. Claimant contacted the office by phone and reports a shoulder injury sustained during the incident. No attorney representation noted at intake. Claimant was advised of the claim process and given the claim number.

Entry 2: Recorded recorded statement from the claimant. Claimant describes stepping out of the vehicle to check the damage when the impact occurred, causing a sudden jolt to the right shoulder. Claimant states pain is ongoing and has limited arm movement. Claimant confirmed they are not represented by counsel and wishes to handle the matter directly. Requested medical records and provider information.

Entry 3: Scene photos and insured's statement reviewed. Insured states the lot was nearly empty and speed was minimal. Damage to both vehicles is consistent with a low-impact collision. Witness information not available. Noted the claimant's account of the shoulder injury as a separate bodily injury component of the claim.

Entry 4: Claimant returned the medical authorization form and provided the name of the treating clinic. Records request sent to the clinic. Claimant indicated a follow-up appointment is scheduled and that a diagnosis is pending imaging results. Reminded claimant to keep all receipts for out-of-pocket expenses related to the injury.

Entry 5: Received preliminary medical summary indicating a soft tissue strain of the right shoulder with a recommended course of physical therapy. Claim file updated to reflect bodily injury evaluation in progress. Claimant was informed that a settlement offer cannot be finalized until treatment status is confirmed. Next review scheduled once the physical therapy progress report is received.
